notes.subject: kalo wolonwulanan, tile tan-ni-duruku-saran, don wolonwula
notes.rationale: Don jatebaw ye jɔyɔrɔ dɔw ye: kalo filanan, tile tan-ni-duruku-saran, don wolonwula.

notes.subject: olosaraka
notes.rationale: עלה kɔrɔ ye «min bɛ taa sanfɛla» ye; «olosaraka» (saraka min bɛ laso bɛɛ di) ye a laada daɲɛ ye Bamanankan na.

notes.subject: לחדש
notes.rationale: חדש bɛ fɔ kalo (don kɔrɔ) walima don-kura don; an ye «don» ta sabu a jira don dɔ ye (tile 15), o tɛ kalo kura don ye.

translation: Kalo wolonwulanan na, tile tan-ni-duruku-saran-na don, don don kɔnɔ, a bɛ o nɔ na kɛ don wolonwula nin donw na, i n'a fɔ jurumusaraka cogo min ye, i n'a fɔ lasaraka min bɛ taa sanfɛla (olosaraka) cogo min ye, ani i n'a fɔ saraka-minɛ cogo min ye, ani tulu cogo min ye.

tokens.gloss: i n'a fɔ jurumusaraka cogo min ye
